title: The Salty Perch
meta_description: Steps from the beach in Seacrest, The Salty Perch offers coastal charm, ocean breezes, and access to a private pool, bikes, and 30A's best attractions.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to The Salty Perch. This luxury 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom home is located on the south side of 30a, in the coastal community of Sunset Villas in Seacrest Beach. You are steps away from the sugar sand beaches and clear gulf waters and after a day in sun, you will enjoy the ocean breezes and view from the swing on the top porch.

ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach is one of the most charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach. Within the Sunset Villas community, there is a private beach and pool less than 100 yards away. The Salty Perch is close to everything you'll love about 30A -- restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and art galleries, and for those wanting to get out and explore nature, 30A has four State Parks, walking/biking trails and fifteen coastal dune lakes. These rare dune lakes are magnificent and something you'll want to see.

BEACH ACCESS: Seacrest Beach Private Beach Access. Wristbands provided in the home

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King, Ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Bunk Room -- Queen/Queen plus 1 Twin Trundle Bed, Ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• 2 bikes included
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Community Pool
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker -- Keurig
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, hand soap, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
